instruction: Candid documentary photograph, medium close-up. In an outdoor backyard with trees and wooden chairs, two friends share a laugh. On the left, the man in the patterned beige t-shirt and pink bandana (R3) is shown in profile, holding a small grey disc and laughing heartily with his mouth open. Behind him on the right, the woman in the white crochet vest and colorful headband (R2) bends forward, laughing along. The lighting is soft and natural, creating a warm, joyful atmosphere with a shallow depth of field blurring the green background.
